en.title: How to Pay Land Development Tax
en.directAnswer: Land development tax is a government land charge. Use the official Ministry of Land service, match the holding and khatian information, pay through the supported method and keep the official receipt or dakhila. Rates and system steps can change, so Justor should re-check the official portal before publication.
